name: AppUi::Editor
description: The standard rich-text component: a controlled Toast UI editor with optional label, ACL and validation message, mentions, #issue links and a read-only viewer.

value.description: The content (html, or markdown with @output markdown)

label.description: Shows a FormFields::Label above the editor

info.description: Help text of the label's info bubble

data-field.description: Identifies the field for the label's info and the message

aclContext.description: ACL context; the editor is rendered only when the user has access

message.description: Validation message, shown once the editor has been left

validate.description: Called with the content when the editor loses focus

usersList.description: Users for @ mentions, each { value, label }

issueSearch.description: Searches issues for # links; returns a promise of the issues

output.description: Format of the content: html or markdown

clearEvent.description: pubSub event that clears this editor

readonly.description: Shows the content in the sanitized viewer instead of the editor

disabled.description: Makes the editor inert and dimmed

onBlur.description: Called when the editor loses focus

onSubmit.description: Called on Ctrl/⌘+Enter with non-empty content

onImage.description: Resolves to { url, alt } of the image to insert
